description: This is a test suite for the GatewayDiscoveryModel component within the OpenClawDiscovery module, focusing on gateway identification, parsing TXT records, SSH target building, discovery continuation logic, and deduplication strategy.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.LocalIdentity
classes.description: Represents the local identity of a gateway, characterized by host tokens and display tokens.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Represents a discovered gateway with various network identifying attributes and configuration.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines whether a given set of network parameters and local identity correspond to a local gateway.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of gateway TXT record fields into a structured record with appropriate default handling.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH connection string from user, host, and port parameters.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.shouldContinueTailscaleServeDiscovery
methods.description: Decides whether to continue the discovery process based on current and known gateways.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.dedupeKey
methods.description: Generates a deduplication key for a gateway, preferring resolved endpoints, or falling back to stable ID.
